services.title: Where do you want to start? See each stage.
services.intro: Five stages, from a fast one-page launch to custom AI engineering. Pick where you are now — that's where we begin.
services.note: Some projects are under NDA. Detailed references available on the diagnostic call.

grants.title: Ai câștigat un grant european sau ODA? Livrăm aplicația din proiect, la termenele din contract.
grants.body: Lucrăm cu startup-uri, IMM-uri, ONG-uri, instituții publice și asociații de afaceri. Intrăm în proiect în orice etapă, de la cererea de finanțare până după încheierea ei.

E.name: EXPRESS PAGE
E.whereYouAre: You need a modern, fast page to validate an idea, win your first customers or replace an outdated site.
E.whatYouGet: A fast-loading 1–3 page landing site, mobile-optimised, wired straight to Telegram or a form so enquiries reach you from day one.

B.name: CONCEPT TO SPEC
B.whereYouAre: You have a product or business idea, but it's still theoretical and you need full clarity before investing in development.
B.whatYouGet: A complete execution plan: from user flows and a visual prototype to a clear technical spec, ready to hand to a dev team.

A.name: DESIGN TO CODE
A.whereYouAre: Your design is ready in Figma, or your visual assets are prepared, and you want a technical team to turn them into well-built production code.
A.whatYouGet: Your Figma screens built as a working app: front end, Postgres database and the API integrations it needs.

C.name: SCALE & EXTEND
C.whereYouAre: You have a live product but need engineering capacity to ship new modules, clear performance bottlenecks or increase delivery speed.
C.whatYouGet: New feature development, code refactoring, database tuning and an architecture ready to scale — with zero downtime.

D.name: AI PROCESS AUTOMATION
D.whereYouAre: Your team loses dozens of hours on repetitive tasks, manual data processing or fragmented workflows that slow your growth.
D.whatYouGet: LLM steps wired into the tools you already use (n8n, Make or custom code), plus a dashboard where your team reviews every automated action.

stack.title: The stack we ship with.
stack.subtitle: TypeScript on both ends, Postgres for data, deployed on Vercel. Tools we've used in production, not a wish list.
stack.integrationNote: Already running a Shopify store or an existing CMS? We integrate natively over headless APIs.

frontend.name: Frontend & UI
frontend.benefit: Performance & SEO: Server-rendered pages with metadata, sitemap and hreflang set up from day one.

backend.name: Backend & Data
backend.benefit: Solid Infrastructure: Postgres with row-level security and migrations kept in Git.

infra.name: Cloud & Infra
infra.benefit: Automated deploys: Every commit reaches production through CI, with a CDN and a preview for every change.

ai.name: AI & Vector Data
ai.benefit: LLM automation: Models wired into your workflows, with semantic search over your own data.

process.title: A clear process, scaled to the size of the project.
process.subtitle: No needless bureaucracy for fast projects. Rigorous architecture for complex systems.
process.disclaimer: *The guarantee covers technical errors and conformance with the agreed specification; design changes or new functionality are scope extensions.

fast.name: Express & Design-to-Code
fast.summary: For landing pages, Express builds and Figma-to-code. Fast delivery with no redundant steps.

steps.title: Fast onboarding & setup
steps.body: A 30-minute call or same-day brief alignment. We confirm scope, access and deliverables.

steps.title: Direct execution
steps.body: We start the build immediately, or translate pixel-perfect from Figma. No intermediate wireframing phase.

steps.title: Rapid staging
steps.body: A live preview link within 24–48 hours. Feedback on the real build, not a mockup.

steps.title: Launch & 30-day support
steps.body: Full handover plus 30 days of technical bug fixes after launch.

deep.name: Concept-to-Spec, scale & AI automations
deep.summary: For custom apps, refactoring and AI automations. Rigorous architecture and sprints with a demo at every milestone.

steps.title: Diagnostic & blueprint
steps.body: A 60-minute discovery, risk analysis and a scope specification within 48 hours.

steps.title: Wireframing & architecture
steps.body: Data models, API contracts and interactive prototypes before the first line of code.

steps.title: Two-week sprints
steps.body: A staging environment updated bi-weekly, with milestone demos at every iteration.

steps.title: Handover & 30-day guarantee
steps.body: Repository transfer, documentation, a handover session and 30 days of support.

about.title: Boutique studio. Senior engineers. Direct access.
about.lead: We run a few projects at a time so each gets the hours it needs. No middlemen mistranslating the requirements, no juniors learning on your budget. You talk directly to the engineer building your product.

ownership.title: 100% ownership from day one
ownership.body: Source code, database and infrastructure are set up directly in your own accounts. You keep full control and can move to another team at any time.

pricing.title: Fixed estimates, owned cost
pricing.body: A fixed price for every agreed stage. If we underestimate the complexity of a task, we absorb the cost of the extra hours.

communication.title: Direct, multilingual communication
communication.body: Technical discussion and clear specs in Romanian, English or Russian. No needless jargon, just fast engineering decisions.

contact.title: Tell us what needs to be built.
contact.lead: A short description of the problem is enough. You get a written answer within one working day, with an honest opinion on whether we are the right studio for it.
